# Charlotte Latin School — Branding — Athletics Logo

**Provenance:** Fetched by Claude on 2026-07-25 via web research, to add the school's
athletics mascot logo to the school-page header in the app.

- **School:** Charlotte Latin School (Charlotte, NC)
- **Mascot / teams:** Hawks
- **Athletic colors:** Navy & white
- **Logo used in app:** `public/logos/charlotte-latin.png` — current (redesigned) Hawks
 mark: a navy hawk's head in profile with silver/grey accents. 1200×800 PNG, transparent
 background. This is the most recent logo version (uploaded Nov 2025).
